mapper.select: SELECT t.name as name, t.phone as phone, t.email as email, t.company_name as company_name, wm_concat ( t.unit_name ) AS unit_name, wm_concat ( t.position_name ) AS position_name FROM ( SELECT fe.name AS name, fe.phone AS phone, fe.email AS email, ( SELECT fc.COMPANY_FULL_NAME FROM FND_COMPANY fc WHERE fc.COMPANY_ID = fea.COMPANY_ID ) AS company_name, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM FND_ORG_UNIT fou WHERE fou.UNIT_ID = fea.UNIT_ID ) AS unit_name, ( SELECT fop.POSITION_NAME FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.POSITION_ID = fea.POSITION_ID ) AS POSITION_NAME FROM FND_EMPLOYEE FE, FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea WHERE fe.EMPLOYEE_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID AND fe.employee_code = #{employeeCode} ) t GROUP BY t.name, t.phone, t.email, t.company_name

SELECT t.name as name, t.phone as phone, t.email as email, t.company_name as company_name, t.employee_code, wm_concat ( t.unit_name ) AS unit_name, wm_concat ( t.position_name ) AS position_name FROM ( SELECT fe.name AS name, fe.phone AS phone, fe.email AS email, fe.employee_code, ( SELECT fc.COMPANY_FULL_NAME FROM FND_COMPANY fc WHERE fc.COMPANY_ID = fea.COMPANY_ID ) AS company_name, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM FND_ORG_UNIT fou WHERE fou.UNIT_ID = fea.UNIT_ID ) AS unit_name, ( SELECT fop.POSITION_NAME FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fop WHERE fop.POSITION_ID = fea.POSITION_ID ) AS POSITION_NAME FROM FND_EMPLOYEE FE, FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea WHERE fe.EMPLOYEE_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID AND fe.phone = #{phone} ) t GROUP BY t.name, t.phone, t.email, t.employee_code, t.company_name

SELECT E1.EMPLOYEE_CODE, E1.NAME, FC.COMPANY_SHORT_NAME as company_name FROM fnd_employee e1 , fnd_org_position p1 , fnd_employee_assigns f1, FND_COMPANY fc WHERE e1.employee_id = f1.employee_id and f1.position_id = p1.position_id and FC.COMPANY_ID=E1.COMPANY_ID
and p1.POSITION_CODE = '120'
and p1.POSITION_CODE = '05400'
and p1.POSITION_CODE = '05520'
and p1.POSITION_TYPE = 'OPERATION'
and (p1.POSITION_CODE = '100504' or p1.POSITION_CODE = '100505')
and p1.POSITION_CODE = '150'
and E1.NAME LIKE concat('%', concat(#{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and E1.EMPLOYEE_CODE LIKE concat('%', concat(#{employeeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
SELECT FOU.UNIT_TYPE FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA, FND_EMPLOYEE FE, FND_ORG_UNIT FOU WHERE FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID = FE.EMPLOYEE_ID AND FEA.UNIT_ID = FOU.UNIT_ID AND FE.EMPLOYEE_CODE = #{employeeCode}

select sua.ALLOCATION_ID as name from fnd_org_position fop, fnd_employee_assigns fea, SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua, SYS_USER su where fea.POSITION_ID = fop.POSITION_ID and SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID and SUA.USER_ID=SU.USER_ID and fop.POSITION_NAME = (select concat(fou.UNIT_NAME,'分管领导') from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.UNIT_ID = #{unitId})

select distinct su.USER_NAME,su.USER_ID,su.EMAIL,fe.NAME from SYS_USER su LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua ON su.USER_ID = sua.USER_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea ON sua.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe ON fea.EMPLOYEE_ID = fe.EMPLOYEE_ID where (su.USER_NAME = #{userName} or fe.NAME = #{userName})

select wm_concat(fe.name) name from FND_EMPLOYEE fe WHERE fe.company_id= #{request.companyId}
and UPPER(fe.employee_code) in
UPPER(#{item})
and UPPER(fe.employee_code)=UPPER(#{employeeCode})

select fe.* from FND_EMPLOYEE fe WHERE fe.company_id=261
and UPPER(fe.employee_code) in
UPPER(#{item})

select distinct sua.allocation_id as user_name from fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_unit fou, sys_user_allocation sua, sys_user su where 1=1 and fou.unit_id=#{unitId} and fea.company_id=fou.company_id and fou.company_id=sua.company_id and fea.company_id=#{companyId} and su.user_id=sua.user_id and fea.employee_assign_id=sua.employee_assign_id and fea.position_id=fou.chief_position_id

SELECT a.allocation_id AS user_name FROM fnd_org_position p, sys_user_allocation a, fnd_employee_assigns e WHERE p.unit_id = #{unitId} AND p.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND a.employee_assign_id = e.employee_assign_id AND p.position_id = e.position_id and a.company_id = #{companyId} and e.company_id = a.company_id

SELECT SU.USER_NAME as name FROM FND_ORG_UNIT fou, FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea, SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua, SYS_USER su WHERE
FOU.UNIT_ID in
#{item}
and FEA.UNIT_ID=FOU.PARENT_UNIT_ID and SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID and SUA.USER_ID=SU.USER_ID

SELECT su.USER_NAME FROM SYS_USER su , SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua , FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea WHERE su.USER_ID = sua.USER_ID AND sua.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fea.POSITION_ID IN( SELECT fou1.CHIEF_POSITION_ID FROM SYS_USER su1 , SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua1 , FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea1 , FND_ORG_UNIT fou1 WHERE su1.USER_ID = sua1.USER_ID AND su1.USER_NAME = #{username} AND fea1.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = sua1.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fou1.UNIT_ID = fea1.UNIT_ID )

SELECT distinct fe.employee_code as employeeCode, fe.name, fe.employee_id as employeeId FROM fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua where fe.EMPLOYEE_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ID and su.USER_ID = sua.USER_ID and sua.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID and fe.enabled_flag ='Y' and su.USER_ID = #{userId} and fea.PRIMARY_POSITION_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT ( CASE u.unit_code WHEN 'BUSINESS_DEPT_OD' THEN ( SELECT sa.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sa, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fp WHERE sa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fea.POSITION_ID = fp.POSITION_ID AND fp.POSITION_CODE = 'A8001' ) WHEN 'BUSINESS_DEPT_TD' THEN ( SELECT sa.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sa, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fp WHERE sa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fea.POSITION_ID = fp.POSITION_ID AND fp.POSITION_CODE = 'A8002' ) WHEN 'BUSINESS_DEPT_THD' THEN ( SELECT sa.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sa, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fp WHERE sa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fea.POSITION_ID = fp.POSITION_ID AND fp.POSITION_CODE = 'A8003' ) WHEN 'BUSINESS_DEPT_ZD' THEN ( SELECT sa.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sa, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fp WHERE sa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fea.POSITION_ID = fp.POSITION_ID AND fp.POSITION_CODE = 'A8004' ) END ) NAME FROM fnd_org_unit u WHERE u.unit_id = #{unitId}
